exposure: Infants cared for at their booking hospital
Infants cared for at a non-booking hospital
outcome: Number of transfers on the first day of life
Time away from the maternal booking hospital
Distance from the maternal residence to the hospital
cohort: 14,719 infants born at 23+0 to 27+6 weeks of gestation and admitted for neonatal care between 2011 and 2016
finding: Centralised neonatal care for extremely preterm infants is associated with a significant increase in time spent away from the maternal booking hospital and distance from the maternal residence.
